title: The Maldives Plans to Offer Residency to the World’s Ultra Rich – And Create Islands From Scratch to Do It
snippet: The debt-distressed Maldives is poised to sell residency and luxury real estate on artificial islands, raising fears of a new offshore tax and money-laundering haven.

title: Croatia Expands Probe Into Alleged Multi-Million-Euro Toxic Waste Scheme

title: Ex-Ukrainian Lawmaker Sent to Trial Over $1.3 Million Fraud Scheme
